critique.evidence: A cohesive, demo-ready visual system carries across desktop, tablet, and mobile: strong editorial headline hierarchy, disciplined dark grid, restrained red/cyan/yellow semantics, consistent mono labels and badges, polished borders, icons, and section framing. Desktop composition is especially confident, and mobile stacking preserves structure without clipping. Remaining weaknesses are responsive refinement: the mobile headline breaks into six abrupt lines, chart/phylogeny labels become extremely small, and the tablet vaccination cards are narrow and text-heavy. Some large graph regions also feel under-filled relative to their containers.
critique.fix: Refine the intermediate and mobile type scales: slightly reduce the mobile hero size or width-pressure, raise minimum sizes for chart/graph annotations, and switch the tablet vaccination sequence to a two-column or horizontally scrollable layout. Enlarge or reframe the phylogeny visualization to use its allotted space more effectively.
